item.title: Police to Resume Enforcement of Tinted Glass Permits from January 2
item.description: Motorists across the country are advised to ensure their vehicle documentation is up to date, as the Nigeria Police Force prepares to clamp down on unauthorized tinted glasses. The Force announced that strict enforcement of tinted glass permits will resume on January 2, 2026. According to police authorities, the moratorium on enforcement is being lifted to address rising security challenges. item.title: Sydney Mourns Victims of Worst Mass Shooting in 30 Years
item.description: Australia has been plunged into mourning following a tragic mass shooting at a Hanukkah festival on Sydney’s Bondi Beach. The attack, which claimed the lives of 15 people, marks the country’s deadliest shooting incident in nearly three decades. As the nation grapples with the shock, tributes have begun to pour in for the victims and the heroes of the day. item.title: FRSC to Prosecute TikTok Star Peller Over Dangerous Driving Stunt
item.description: The Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) has announced it will prosecute popular TikTok streamer Habeeb Hamzat, known online as Peller, following a car crash linked to reckless driving. item.title: MIPAD Awards to Honor Sanwo-Olu, Davido, and Corporate Titans in Lagos
item.description: For the first time in its history, the Most Influential People of African Descent (MIPAD) recognition ceremony will move from its traditional home in New York to Lagos. The prestigious event is scheduled for Sunday, December 21, marking the climax of the week-long Lagos Diaspora Experience 2025.
